The repo itself never needs this — PI loads TypeScript through jiti — but a package that only ships .ts cannot be imported by plain Node at all (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING refuses to strip types under node_modules) and forces every consumer to set `allowImportingTsExtensions`. `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` is what lets the source keep its explicit `.ts` specifiers while the emitted JS says `.js`.
